plugins.name: signalpilot-dbt
plugins.description: Governed AI database access for dbt and SQL — sandboxed queries, schema discovery, and intelligent model building powered by SignalPilot

skills.name: bigquery-sql
skills.description: BigQuery-specific SQL patterns: UNNEST for array expansion, STRUCT, ARRAY_AGG, DATE_DIFF/DATE_ADD, backtick-quoted table references, EXCEPT/REPLACE in SELECT, approximate aggregation, partitioned and wildcard tables.
skills.description_zh: 提供 BigQuery 专用 SQL 写法，涵盖 UNNEST 数组展开、STRUCT、ARRAY_AGG、日期差和加减、反引号表引用、SELECT 的 EXCEPT/REPLACE、近似聚合、分区及通配表。

skills.name: dbt-date-spines
skills.description: Fix current_date/now() hazards in dbt date spine models. Replaces nondeterministic date references with data-driven boundaries from get_date_boundaries.
headings: dbt Date Spine Hazard — Fixing current_date in Model Files
skills.description_zh: 修复 dbt 日期骨架模型使用 current_date 或 now() 的不确定性，以 get_date_boundaries 从数据推导的边界替代动态日期引用。

skills.name: dbt-debugging
skills.description: Load when dbt run or dbt parse fails. Covers YML duplicate patches, ref errors, passthrough model warnings, current_date fixes, DuckDB error messages, and zero-row diagnosis.
skills.description_zh: 排查 dbt run 或 dbt parse 失败，涵盖 YML 重复 patch、ref 错误、透传模型警告、current_date 修复、DuckDB 错误信息和零行结果诊断。

skills.name: dbt-knowledgebase
skills.description: Populate the knowledge base from dbt project research. Proposes entries across all 6 categories at org, project, and connection scopes.
skills.description_zh: 依据 dbt 项目研究提出知识库条目，覆盖组织、项目和连接层级的六类知识。

skills.name: dbt-snapshots
skills.description: Load when task involves dbt snapshots, SCD Type 2, or tracking data changes over time. Covers strategy selection, column casing, verification, and common pitfalls.
skills.description_zh: 处理 dbt snapshots、SCD Type 2 和跨时间数据变更追踪，涵盖策略选择、字段大小写、验证及常见问题。

skills.name: dbt-testing
skills.description: Load when task involves adding, writing, or fixing dbt unit tests. Covers unit_tests YAML format, given/expect blocks, edge-case coverage, and the difference between unit tests and schema tests.
headings: Run unit tests for a specific model
Run all unit tests in the project
skills.description_zh: 新增、编写或修复 dbt 单元测试，涵盖 unit_tests YAML、given/expect 区块、边界情况覆盖及单元测试与 schema 测试的区别。

skills.name: dbt-versioning
skills.description: Load when task involves dbt model versioning, creating v2 of a model, or backward-compatible model changes. Covers versions YAML config, defined_in, latest_version, and ref() with version pins.
skills.description_zh: 处理 dbt 模型版本管理、创建 v2 或向后兼容变更，涵盖 versions YAML、defined_in、latest_version 及固定版本的 ref()。

skills.name: dbt-workflow
skills.description: Load FIRST before any dbt project work. Covers the full 8-step dbt workflow: project scanning, skill loading, validation, macro discovery, research, technical spec, SQL writing, and verification. Also covers output shape inference, incremental model handling, and what to trust in YML.
headings: dbt Workflow Skill - Full Project Lifecycle
map_columns - Upstream column mapper (MCP tool, Step 7)
Step 3 - Validate and fix stale upstreams
Step 7 - Write and Build ALL Models
skills.description_zh: 提供 dbt 项目的八步工作流：扫描项目、加载技能、校验、发现宏、研究、技术规格、编写 SQL 和验证，另涵盖输出形态推断、增量模型和 YML 信息可信范围。原说明要求 dbt 项目工作先采用本项。

skills.name: dbt-write
skills.description: Loaded at Step 2 for the full workflow. Covers column naming, type preservation, JOIN defaults, lookup joins, sibling models, materialization, packages, and filtering rules.
headings: 2. Sibling Models - Start from the Pattern, Extend Where Needed
5. Do NOT Add Filters Unless Explicitly Required
9. Use Ref Models Instead of Recomputing
skills.description_zh: 在完整 dbt 工作流第 2 步加载，指导字段命名、类型保留、JOIN 默认规则、查找表连接、同级模型、物化、依赖包和过滤规则。

skills.name: domain-ecommerce
skills.description: E-commerce domain knowledge: transaction lifecycle, driving tables, status filtering.
headings: Revenue Metrics MUST Exclude Non-Sale Events
skills.description_zh: 提供电商数据领域规则，涵盖交易生命周期、驱动表选择及状态过滤。

skills.name: domain-financial
skills.description: Financial reporting rules: grain consistency, balance sheets, double-entry ledgers, fiscal year boundaries, period-over-period calculations.
skills.description_zh: 提供财务报表规则，涵盖粒度一致性、资产负债表、复式记账账簿、财年边界和跨期计算。

skills.name: domain-healthcare
skills.description: Healthcare data science rules: encounter-based grain, clinical coding hierarchies, cost allocation, NULL semantics in clinical data.
skills.description_zh: 提供医疗数据科学规则，涵盖就诊粒度、临床编码层级、成本分摊及临床数据中的 NULL 语义。

skills.name: domain-hr
skills.description: HR & operations rules: SCD current-record filtering, issue resolution metrics.
skills.description_zh: 提供人力与运营数据规则，涵盖缓慢变化维度的当前记录过滤和问题解决指标。

skills.name: domain-marketing
skills.description: Marketing domain knowledge: attribution models, engagement funnel order.
skills.description_zh: 提供营销数据领域知识，涵盖归因模型及互动漏斗阶段顺序。

skills.name: domain-media
skills.description: Media & entertainment domain knowledge: content catalogs, participation tables, ranking determinism.
headings: WARNING: Use the Broadest Table Available
skills.description_zh: 提供媒体娱乐数据领域知识，涵盖内容目录、参与关系表及排名结果的确定性。

skills.name: domain-product
skills.description: Product analytics rules: calendar spine cross-joins, date boundary caps, event type pivoting, first-run NULL behavior.
skills.description_zh: 提供产品分析规则，涵盖日历骨架交叉连接、日期边界上限、事件类型透视及首次运行的 NULL 行为。

skills.name: duckdb-sql
skills.description: Load when hitting DuckDB syntax errors or writing DuckDB-specific SQL. Covers gotchas that differ from PostgreSQL/MySQL.
headings: DuckDB SQL - Key Differences from PostgreSQL/MySQL
skills.description_zh: 在编写 DuckDB 专用 SQL 或遇到语法错误时使用，说明其与 PostgreSQL、MySQL 不同的易错点。

skills.name: knowledge-base
skills.description: Write a technical spec after research. Distills exploration into structured decisions. On retries, read the existing spec instead of re-researching.
headings: 7. What Does NOT Go in the Spec
skills.description_zh: 在研究后将探索结果提炼为结构化技术决策规格；重试时读取已有规格，避免重复研究。

skills.name: notion-context
skills.description: Gather business context from Notion before dbt builds. Searches all configured integrations, extracts definitions/decisions/constraints, writes structured context for the build agent and notion-verify subagent.
headings: Report Integration: <integration with report destination configured>
Sources: <N> pages searched across <M> integrations, <K> items extracted

skills.name: signalpilot
skills.description: BLOCKING REQUIREMENT: If the user's message mentions dbt, SQL, database, or data pipeline — invoke this skill as your FIRST tool call, BEFORE Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, or Agent. Covers: SignalPilot MCP tools, available skills, and the governed workflow for dbt projects, SQL queries, schema discovery, and database access.
headings: SQL (load the one matching your database)
Domain knowledge (load the one matching the data)
skills.description_zh: 作为 SignalPilot 的数据库工作入口，说明 MCP 工具、可用技能和受治理的 dbt 项目、SQL、结构发现及数据库访问流程。原说明要求遇到 dbt、SQL、数据库或数据管道请求时，在其他读取搜索命令前优先调用；此为源技能规定。

skills.name: snowflake-sql
skills.description: Snowflake-specific SQL patterns: QUALIFY for window filtering, LATERAL FLATTEN for arrays, semi-structured VARIANT data, ILIKE for case-insensitive matching, date functions, and time travel.
headings: 3. Arrays and Semi-Structured Data - LATERAL FLATTEN
skills.description_zh: 提供 Snowflake 专用 SQL 写法，涵盖 QUALIFY 窗口过滤、LATERAL FLATTEN 数组展开、半结构化 VARIANT、ILIKE、日期函数和时间旅行查询。

skills.name: sql-workflow
skills.description: Use this skill before writing any SQL query. Covers: output shape inference (cardinality clues from the question), efficient schema exploration, iterative CTE-based query building, structured verification loop (row count, NULL audit, fan-out check, sample inspection), error recovery protocol, saving output to result.sql and result.csv, turn budget management, and common benchmark traps.
headings: 2. Output Shape Inference - Before Writing SQL
skills.description_zh: 指导 SQL 编写前的工作流，根据问题推断输出形态和基数，高效探索结构、迭代构建 CTE，验证行数、NULL、连接放大和样本，并处理错误、保存 result.sql/result.csv、管理回合预算及规避常见评测陷阱。

skills.name: sqlite-sql
skills.description: SQLite-specific SQL patterns: substr/instr for string ops, || for concatenation, LIKE (no ILIKE), date()/strftime() for dates, CAST for type coercion, no FULL OUTER JOIN, GROUP_CONCAT, typeof(), COALESCE/IFNULL, printf() formatting.
headings: 6. No FULL OUTER JOIN - Simulate with UNION
skills.description_zh: 提供 SQLite SQL 写法，包括 substr/instr、双竖线拼接、LIKE、date/strftime、CAST、GROUP_CONCAT、typeof、COALESCE/IFNULL 和 printf。原说明列出无 ILIKE 及不使用 FULL OUTER JOIN 的约束，实际版本能力需另行核验。

skills.name: write-report
skills.description: Generates an HTML report summarizing dbt project work: decisions, SQL, queries, verifier results, and visual charts. Only load when explicitly requested.
skills.description_zh: 仅在明确要求时生成总结 dbt 项目工作的 HTML 报告，包含决策、SQL、查询、验证结果和可视化图表。
